audience: rental businesses that take bookings and manage orders in Booqable

useCases.title: Review rental orders by status or rental period
useCases.text: The AI lists orders filtered by search text, status, payment status, customer or rental period, and reads one order with its customer and lines.

useCases.title: Check if a product is available for a date
useCases.text: The AI checks how many units can be booked for an exact period at a location, or reads a product's day-by-day availability calendar for a month.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a customer
useCases.text: The AI searches customers by name, email or tag and reads order count, revenue and balance due. It can create a customer or change one.

useCases.title: Create a rental order or change an existing one
useCases.text: The AI creates an order for a rental period, books products on it and reserves it. It can also change the period, customer or locations of an order.

useCases.title: Check invoices, quotes and payments
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices, quotes and contracts with totals and payment status, and payments for an order or customer.

useCases.title: Read or add internal notes on a record
useCases.text: The AI lists internal notes on a customer, order or product, and attaches a new note to one of them.
